program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            candidates = [
                grid[h - 1 - r][c],
                grid[r][w - 1 - c],
                grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c],
            ]
            if h == w:
                candidates.extend([
                    grid[c][r],
                    grid[h - 1 - c][w - 1 - r],
                    grid[c][w - 1 - r],
                    grid[h - 1 - c][r],
                ])
            values = [value for value in candidates if value != 2]
            if values:
                out[r][c] = values[0]
    return out
'''
